content:
The Apple annual product launch event - the September iPhone launch event is just one month away, based on various reports, here are the products expected to be launched.

iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra

According to reports, this year's flagship iPhone lineup will be the year with the fewest models in many years, and also the most expensive one.

Because there are multiple signs indicating that the standard iPhone 18 will not ship until early 2027, and the iPhone Air 2 is also expected to be delayed.

Therefore, next month is expected to see three new iPhones:

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, new colours, smaller Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: All of the above features, plus a larger battery
  • iPhone Ultra: A brand-new design, Apple's first foldable iPhone

Analysts expect the iPhone 18 Pro to start at around US$1,399, while the iPhone Ultra is expected to retail at around US$1,999. Hopefully Apple will price them lower than expected.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12

New Apple Watch models appear every September, and this year is expected to be no exception.

Here are the two new Apple Watch models rumoured:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, refreshed design, and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: More powerful SiP, new health features

Details on both new watches remain quite limited for now. This may mean the changes this year are relatively minor — or it could just be that Apple still has many surprises yet to be announced.

Variables: New AirPods Pro, Apple Home products

iPhone and Apple Watch are almost certain to appear at the September event, but Apple may also take the opportunity to launch other products.

Among them, the most likely are new AirPods and Apple Home products.

  • AirPods Pro with camera: The camera is used to power AI features, with potential applications including health and accessibility functions
  • New Apple TV 4K: More powerful chip to support Apple Intelligence and Siri AI
  • HomePad/HomePod Touch: A display-equipped HomePod with Siri at its core
  • HomePod mini 2: Support for Siri AI, new chip, better sound quality
  • HomePod 3: Support for Siri AI and new chip, with relatively limited other changes
  • Apple Home Security Camera: A home security camera supporting HomeKit Secure Video

Apple still has many other autumn products that may debut next month, such as the new OLED iPad mini, new MacBook Pro and Ultra models, and more. However, the consensus expectation is that these products will be delayed until the October event.

Which Apple product are you planning to pick up at the September event? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
